info.sourceDesc: CastNow is an open-source high-performance P2P engine. The source code is available on GitHub under the MIT license.
info.supportDesc: Having trouble or have questions? We're here to help. CastNow is a community-driven project dedicated to private P2P communication.
info.stepEmail: Email us directly for technical support or feedback.
info.stepGithub: Report bugs or request features via our GitHub repository.
info.privacyDesc: We value your privacy. CastNow utilizes direct End-to-End Peer-to-Peer connections.
info.privacy1: Your stream data never touches our servers.
info.privacy2: No recordings are stored or processed by us.
info.privacy3: We do not collect or sell personal demographic data.
info.termsDesc: By using CastNow, you agree that you are solely responsible for the content you broadcast.
info.termsDisclaimer: The service is provided 'as is' without warranties of any kind. Misuse for illegal activities will result in termination of service.
